description: This file defines the Config class within the OpenCart system engine namespace, responsible for managing configuration data including paths, loading configuration files, and providing getter/setter methods for configuration data.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Class for managing configuration data, including adding paths, loading config files, and retrieving configuration values.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path for a given namespace, updating internal path mappings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a configuration key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specific value.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a configuration file based on the filename, handling path resolution, and merges its contents into internal data.
